title: Export & print-friendly results
description:
Let users take the data with them: add CSV export and a print/PDF-friendly view for any results table (query-builder results, entity lists, and report tables). Export respects current filters/sort so the user gets exactly what they see. Print view strips app chrome and renders a clean titled table (usable via browser Print-to-PDF). Small, self-contained, no backend.

Part of Phase 3 (Query & Reports). Rounds out 'get tables and reports' — usable outputs, not just on-screen views.
acceptance_criteria: Any results table (query builder, entity list, report) has a 'Download CSV' action that exports the currently filtered/sorted rows
Exported CSV opens cleanly in a spreadsheet with correct headers and values (commas/quotes escaped)
A print-friendly view renders a titled, chrome-free table suitable for browser Print-to-PDF
Export/print reflect the exact current view (filters + sort applied)
Works entirely client-side with no backend dependency
